svg.text: FFL 1677.50 · Compact family-hall house · terrace master
1:100 at A3 · field frame rotated to grid north · contours 1 m from survey TIN
Front door on the west façade opens into a
straight entrance hall. The stair and lift
face it from the core lobby.
Groceries: garage → fire door → core lobby →
Two 3.35 m shutters; 4.2 m wide bays, so every
car door opens fully. Workbench and bike wall
Plant room is off the entrance hall; modules
go out through the 1.2 m front door. Office
looks east over the roof deck.
